description: This file defines the public interface for spinlock synchronization primitives in the Zephyr RTOS, including structures, inline functions for locking/unlocking, and validation mechanisms.

methods.name: k_spin_lock
methods.description: Locks a spinlock, disables interrupts, and returns a key for unlocking.

methods.name: k_spin_trylock
methods.description: Attempts to lock a spinlock without blocking, returns success or busy.

methods.name: k_spin_unlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired spinlock using the key.
